Define Space d := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d); objective f x := (1/(m:ℝ))*∑i,f i x. RegularObjective enumerates differentiability of every component, global lower bound, Lminus gradient Lipschitz bound, Lplus mean-square bound, Lpm centered difference bound and supplied initial gap. It contains no algorithmic conclusions.
JobKind is single x or difference x y. Job holds component Fin m, kind, finite nonnegative start time and unique dispatch ID. Request holds current finite nonnegative clock and one pending job per worker Fin n. Query is Option Request; Reply is Option (worker, dispatch ID, finite nonnegative completion clock, vector). Define measurable structures explicitly by encoding these finite sums/products. Supply the canonical Option measurable-space instance by comap along None ↦ Sum.inl () and Some a ↦ Sum.inr a; use that same instance throughout the protocol. This shared supporting-definition/assumption module belongs in Proofs: the native role router permits assumptions in Proofs, while every Setups module must export a concrete spec. Only the five public specs belong in Setups. No Seed type restriction is added to Oracle.
jobWork is 1 or 2; jobValue is the corresponding exact component gradient or difference. deadline τ job i = start + jobWork*τ i in ℝ≥0∞. legalRequest means at least one pending job exists, every pending job starts no later than the current clock, and no pending deadline precedes it. Idle or empty-pending states use None, never a supposedly active empty request. PrimitiveService is joint measurability of answers plus a full oracle-tape measure set on which, for every call and legal active request, a real matching completion is returned: time is at least the request clock, at most every pending deadline, the chosen ID is the actual pending ID, and the returned value is jobValue. Idle queries return idle replies. This is primitive service behavior, not a batch time, variance or convergence bound. LiveService records finite actual next completion while a worker can finish; infinite advertised bounds do not create a completion at infinity. FreshAssignments describes conditional uniform selection from the current remaining multiset (full) or all components (difference); it will be proved from private seed laws, not required as an unexplained oracle guarantee.
equilibriumTime τ r := ⨅ j : Fin n, (r+(j.val+1:ℕ))/(∑i∈Finset.Iic j,(τ i)⁻¹), in ℝ≥0∞. largeSample m n := (n:ℝ)*Real.log n ≤ m.
Owned source contracts, including their scoped premises: FiniteSum: [average] f(x)=m^{-1} sum_{i=1}^m fi(x).
OptimizationAssumptions: [smooth_lower] For every x, lower<=f(x); ||grad f(x)-grad f(y)||<=Lminus||x-y||. [mean_square] For every x,y, m^{-1}sum_i||grad fi(x)-grad fi(y)||^2<=Lplus^2||x-y||^2. [centered] For every x,y, m^{-1}sum_i||grad fi(x)-grad fi(y)||^2-||grad f(x)-grad f(y)||^2<=Lpm^2||x-y||^2. [gap] f(x0)-lower<=Delta.
WorkerModel: [service] Each worker handles one assigned job at a time. Its completed value is the exact assigned component gradient; a difference job computes two assigned component gradients. Each primitive-gradient duration is nonnegative and at most that worker tau; simultaneous completions have a specified tie rule. [fresh_assignments] At every assignment, draw a fresh uniform label from the current uncollected multiset for a full collector, or from all m labels for a difference collector. Fresh Bernoulli refresh draws and the output-index draw are independent of the past and of these draws. [liveness] Some worker can complete its assigned computations in finite time, including after reassignment. Other workers may never finish. Every returned completion event is an actual finite-time event.
EquilibriumTime: [formula] t(r)=min_{j in {1,...,n}} (sum_{i=1}^j tau_i^{-1})^{-1}(r+j).
LargeSample: [large] m>=n*log(n).
edge_cases: d may be zero. m,n must be positive only in valid/source hypotheses. τ is sorted and may contain zero or infinity. Source liveness permits finite completions even when every advertised bound is infinity. Measurability and a common full-measure primitive-service event permit adaptive queries without uncountable null-set intersections.
